structuralFindings: Currency USD, confirmed ('Market Code Rack Rate / Currency USD').

Base meal plan is Half Board for this rate table ('Based on Half Board') — a Bed & Breakfast REDUCTION of -$15 is applied if guest wants BB instead, rather than BB being a separate priced row (different shape from the 2027 document, see that file's notes).
5 room categories: Standard Room, Deluxe Room, Deluxe Bungalow Room, Suite with Seaview — plus a separate 'Room-Surcharge for Seaview' flat add-on ($39) applicable to the base categories.

5 seasonal date-range columns: Main Season (01/11/25-22/12/25), Festive Season (23/12/25-02/01/26), Main Season (03/01/26-02/04/26), Easter (03/04/26-06/04/26), Main Season (07/04/26-31/10/26) — note 'Main Season' label reused three times for non-contiguous windows, all at the same price point.
Deluxe Bungalow Room explicitly stated as suitable for 2 adults + 1 child.
Standard Room and Deluxe Room available with interconnecting door; Standard/Deluxe/Deluxe Bungalow available with twin or king beds.
10% longstay discount for bookings of more than 7 nights. Group perk: 1 free guest per 15 full-paying adult guests.

Honeymoon package (welcome cocktail, flowers/fruit, sparkling wine, candlelight dinner on 'Imani Dhow' excl. drinks, room upgrade subject to availability excl. suites) for couples married within 6 months, min 3-night stay.

Children policy: infants 0-2 free; children 3-12 sharing with adult = $26 flat (not a % of adult rate — a flat per-person-per-night child rate, differs structurally from every % based property in this batch).
Transport: SGR-Station Transfer $28/person one-way, Airport Transfer $23/person one-way.
Strict cancellation: 100% of booking value charged for cancellation within 48 hours of noon on arrival date, or no-show — a much tighter window than any other property in this batch.
Early check-in from 6am = 50% of room rate; before 6am = 100% of room rate. Late check-out until 6pm = 50%; after 6pm = 100%.
Rooms must be booked as single OR double occupancy for the entire stay — no switching mid-stay; additional guests for single nights not allowed.
